risk_if_not_implemented: Without Retain Access Records, unauthorized individuals, devices or services may gain access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services, Data and/or Facilities (TAASDF). Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Account Management
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to:
(1) Define authorized system account types;
(2) Define prohibited system account types; and
(3) Proactively govern individual, group, system, service, application, guest and temporary accounts.
compensating_control_1.justification: Account Management (IAC-08) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Retain Access Records (IAC-03.2) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Periodic Review of Individual & Service Account Privileges
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to periodically-review the privileges assigned to individuals and service accounts to validate the need for such privileges and reassign or remove unnecessary privileges, as necessary.
compensating_control_2.justification: Periodic Review of Individual & Service Account Privileges (IAC-12) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Retain Access Records (IAC-03.2) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
